run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion fine-tuning on SDXL with a dataset of images and a placeholder token
save_textual_inversion_embeddings: save learned textual inversion embeddings to a safetensors file for later use
validate_textual_inversion_model: validate a textual inversion model by generating images from a prompt during training
create_textual_inversion_dataset: create a textual inversion dataset with image paths, tokenizers, and augmentation transforms
save_textual_inversion_model_card: save a model card with generated example images and metadata for a textual inversion repo
